description: China's overseas contracted engineering projects (对外承包工程) — monthly YEAR-TO-DATE CUMULATIVE value of newly signed contracts and completed turnover, both in USD 100M, each with year-over-year %. Sourced live from MOFCOM's (商务部) data centre, keyless. Values reset down every January. Answers "value of China's overseas construction/engineering contracts", "Chinese contractors' overseas project turnover".

end_period.description: Latest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM. Omit for the most recent available month.

limit.description: Max rows to return, newest first (default 24, max 500). Ignored range still comes from start_period/end_period — this only caps how many of those rows come back.

start_period.description: Earliest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM (e.g. "2024-01" or "202401"). Omit for full history.

name: mofcom_overseas_contracting
